text: This report responds to the request for the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation to report back to the April 28, 2021 meeting of the Infrastructure and Environment Committee with a plan to open all parks washrooms earlier than the Victoria Day long weekend, and as quickly as possible. The COVID-19 pandemic has resulted in the heavy use of parks through the summer and winter months. In support of the need for essential fresh air and exercise, seasonal washrooms closed during the winter will be opened early this spring. Staff began preparing seasonal washrooms for opening in late March and expect all to be open by May 7, 2021. In 2020, 187 park washrooms were open from spring to fall and this year approximately the same number will be open to the public. As park washrooms are opened, the City's website has been updated with information about washroom location and hours.
The Infrastructure and Environment Committee received the report (April 15, 2021) from the General Manager, Parks, Forestry, and Recreation for information.
